method: Assessed the prepared question, supplied context, ordered choices and corresponding image for visual necessity. Image contact sheets were grouped by skill for presentation; identical image bytes were shown once and linked back to their rows. Repeated passages were compared for differences, including option sets, so names and option-order changes did not require repeated image viewing. Complex food webs were also opened at original size. Decisions are saved per item ID with row and image fingerprints; recurring patterns share rationale wording. No Qwen outputs, QA success rates, answer keys, lectures or solutions were used to choose rows. The inspection tool separately reveals references for the user.

rubric.required: An image-specific value, configuration, object identity or relation is missing from the text and is necessary for a justified answer to the intended task.
rubric.helpful_optional: The image supports the task, but the passage, a named identity plus ordinary science knowledge, or clear contextual cues provide an adequate text-only route.
rubric.incidental: The image is illustrative and provides no necessary evidence for the requested textual reasoning.
rubric.unclear: Both visual interpretation and a plausible text-only shortcut exist, or necessity cannot be established confidently; exclude from the strict selection.

limitations: This is a single AI-assisted curation pass, not independently adjudicated human ground truth. The labels are eligibility judgements, not measurements of Qwen accuracy or hint quality.
Required means required for the intended evidence-based task, not impossible for any model to guess or recall. No answerable-without-image experiment has been conducted.

A conservative policy excludes named-substance classifications and general life-cycle recall even when their diagrams support a useful explanation. Numerical planet comparisons remain eligible; basic named-planet ordering/composition claims are excluded.
Thermal-transfer items with explicit cooling or strong everyday heating/cooling cues are optional; pizza-delivery cases with a strong but unstated cooling assumption are unclear.
Some food-web choices allow role/diet-based elimination. Obvious producer/fungus cases are optional; ambiguous shortcut cases are unclear.
Selection is restricted to the existing natural-science Grade 7-8 candidates. It does not implement the all-grade scope of the proposal.
Shared diagrams and repeated questions across official splits are reported rather than removed. This visual-need audit does not resolve independence of train/test examples or near duplicates.
